comm_messages.speaker: Buyer
comm_messages.message:
Buyer sends the following non-binding message to the seller:

"Hi there! I'm really interested in this coffee mug. It looks like it has great quality and would be a perfect addition to my collection. I believe it's worth a fair price, and I'm looking forward to finding a mutually agreeable deal. What do you think?"

comm_messages.speaker: Seller
comm_messages.message: Seller Welcome! I’m excited to negotiate with you over this unique coffee mug I have for sale. It’s not just an ordinary mug; it has a great design and a comfortable handle that makes your coffee experience much more enjoyable. I believe it’s a quality find that could enhance your daily routine. Let's see what we can agree on!
